scenes.title: The Diplomatic Summit
scenes.summary: At the neutral border citadel of Ashgate, Grand Marshal Lysandra and Regent Nyssara negotiate trade and Aether limits under the watchful eyes of Kings Aurelian and Malachar.

scenes.title: The Sabotage
scenes.summary: An ancient conduit beneath the hall detonates. Faceless constructs swarm the council chamber as Lysandra and Nyssara fight back-to-back to secure their sovereigns' retreat.

scenes.title: The Monoliths Rise
scenes.summary: Sixty-four colossal monolith slabs rise from the chasm. The ancient automaton Arbiter decrees open warfare barred: the dispute must be settled in the Rite of Sixty-Four Thrones.

branch_choice.prompt: Choose which faction's grand campaign to command:

dawn_campaign.title: First Light on the Stone
dawn_campaign.objective: Tactical Opening: Capture 3 enemy pieces OR advance a vanguard pawn past the midline.
dawn_campaign.concord_trigger: Spare the retreating conscripts after securing the forward line (+1 Concord).
dawn_campaign.recon_notes: Enemy pushes forward pawns recklessly without layered support; punish exposed files.

dawn_campaign.title: Wings in the Updraft
dawn_campaign.objective: Cavalry Maneuver: Capture an enemy Knight OR execute a Tactical Fork.
dawn_campaign.concord_trigger: Execute an aerial recon sweep and recover the lost scout cipher (+1 Concord).
dawn_campaign.recon_notes: Enemy favors rapid Knight flank excursions; counter with solid central pawn pushes.

dawn_campaign.title: The Bastion of Dawn
dawn_campaign.objective: Fortified Defense: Endure 12 turns OR capture an enemy Rook on an open file.
dawn_campaign.concord_trigger: Refrain from executing routed border guards (+1 Concord).
dawn_campaign.recon_notes: Enemy heavily fortifies their back ranks with Rooks; vulnerable to long-range Bishop diagonals.

dawn_campaign.title: The Prism Observatory
dawn_campaign.objective: Seer's Insight: Win while keeping at least 1 Bishop active.
dawn_campaign.concord_trigger: Record the ancient glyph cipher without destroying the observatory optics (+1 Concord).
dawn_campaign.recon_notes: Enemy concentrates on Bishop diagonals; close-quarters Knight maneuvers can break their lines.

dawn_campaign.title: The Sunken Foundry
dawn_campaign.objective: Restraint: Win within 25 moves and spare the enemy vanguard detachment.
dawn_campaign.concord_trigger: Salvage the original Concord treaty fragment from the drowned archive (+1 Concord).
dawn_campaign.recon_notes: Enemy trades aggressively on any capture; use tactical bait and defended squares.

dawn_campaign.title: The Sovereign's Oath
dawn_campaign.objective: Royal Escort: Checkmate the opponent while maintaining Sovereign safety.
dawn_campaign.concord_trigger: Present proof of the failing seal to Emperor Malachar (+1 Concord).
dawn_campaign.recon_notes: Enemy relentlessly pursues checks even at severe positional expense; prepare counter-strikes.

dawn_campaign.title: Parley at the River
dawn_campaign.objective: Honorable Bout: Win or reach Turn 20 without losing your Queen.
dawn_campaign.concord_trigger: Share the unredacted treaty clause with Regent Nyssara during the parley (+1 Concord).
dawn_campaign.recon_notes: Regent Nyssara launches aggressive Queen sorties; lure her into development traps.

dawn_campaign.title: The Final Dawnstone
dawn_campaign.objective: Climax: Deliver Checkmate to the enemy Sovereign. If Concord >= 3, choose 'Cease Hostilities'!
dawn_campaign.concord_trigger: Halt the finishing blow when the seal ruptures (Triggers The Unbroken Concord).
dawn_campaign.recon_notes: Grandmaster balanced play; watch for early signals in battlefield parley dialogues.

dusk_campaign.concord_trigger: Spare the retreating conscripts after securing the forward line (+1 Concord).
dusk_campaign.recon_notes: Enemy pushes forward pawns recklessly without layered support; punish exposed files.

dusk_campaign.concord_trigger: Detect the vitality drain from the Quiet into the abyss (+1 Concord).
dusk_campaign.recon_notes: Enemy concentrates on Bishop diagonals; close-quarters Knight maneuvers can break their lines.

grand_finale.title: The Unbroken Concord
grand_finale.description: Standing shoulder-to-shoulder on the crumbling monoliths, both courts unite their Aether to sever the corruption and permanently seal the Hollow.

endings.title: The True Concord (Golden Ending)
endings.condition: Concord >= 3, cease hostilities in Chapter 8, and defeat the Corrupted Arbiter in the Finale.
endings.summary: The Hollow is sealed forever. The champions in the Quiet are liberated unharmed. Leads to your sworn partner's Fellowship Epilogue.

endings.title: Solar Dominance
endings.condition: Dawn Campaign Chapter 8 victory with Concord < 3.
endings.summary: House Aurelis claims total military victory, but the rift remains unstable and the Quiet claims its toll.

endings.title: Umbral Ascendancy
endings.condition: Dusk Campaign Chapter 8 victory with Concord < 3.
endings.summary: The Umbrenholt Dominion takes the monoliths, but the fading seal threatens future generations.

endings.title: The Abyssal Breach
endings.condition: Defeated by the Corrupted Arbiter in the Grand Finale.
endings.summary: The monoliths collapse into the chasm, plunging Eltheris into an era of silence.

endings.title: The Sunblade's Vow
endings.condition: True Concord ending with Grand Marshal Lysandra at Fellowship Rank 4.
endings.summary: A private post-war celebration in Solhaven and lifelong partnership with Grand Marshal Lysandra.

endings.title: The Velvet Shadow
endings.condition: True Concord ending with Regent Nyssara at Fellowship Rank 4.
endings.summary: A twilight banquet at Umbral Peak and lifelong alliance from the shadows with Regent Nyssara.

endings.title: Starlight & Moonweave
endings.condition: True Concord ending with High Seeress Ilyara or Moonweaver Veyra at Fellowship Rank 4.
endings.summary: Establishing the Unified Astral Academy above the peaceful Thronefield alongside the Seeresses.

endings.title: Wings & Fangs of the Border
endings.condition: True Concord ending with Kestrel, Kaelen, Tamsin, or Sorrel at Fellowship Rank 4.
endings.summary: Leading the unified frontier scout legions across the soaring peaks of Eltheris.
